info.title: API.SH: Crexi
info.description: The Crexi API from API.SH: public Crexi data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Crexi broker's public profile (name, photo, brokerage with website and logo, licenses, member since) and their properties for sale, newest first. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crexi-broker

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
US commercial spaces for lease on Crexi by place, property type, building class or keyword: id, link, name, status, type and subtype, building size, buildings, lot size, tenancy, vacant units, available spaces (rentable square feet, range, rate type), dates, photos, brokers and addresses with coordinates. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crexi-leases

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, county, state or ZIP as written on the site (e.g. "Austin, TX", "Texas", "78701").

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Building class, comma-separated: A, B, C, D.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Crexi listing (for sale or for lease): name, summary, status, asking price, types, subtypes, tenants, the property details table (values the site hides from signed-out visitors are left out), investment highlights, marketing description, auction terms, offers-due date, Opportunity Zone, dates, locations with coordinates, lease suites, every photo and video, and each broker with brokerage, address, website, licenses and listing count. Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crexi-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (the number in crexi.com/properties/<id>/...). Or give `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A crexi.com listing link (sale or /lease/properties/ link).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: sale or lease, when giving a bare lease id.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. type, state), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
US commercial properties for sale on Crexi with the site's search filters: property type and subtype, state, ZIP, keyword, asking price, cap rate, building size, price per square foot, occupancy, tenancy, tenant brand and credit, investment type, Opportunity Zone and broker. Each result has id, link, name, status (On-Market, Auction...), asking price, types, investment type, square feet, cap rate, lot size, offers-due date, dates, media flags, thumbnail, brokerage and locations with coordinates. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crexi-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Property types, comma-separated: Retail, Multifamily, Office, Industrial, Hospitality, Mixed Use, Land, Self Storage, Mobile Home Park, Senior Living, Special Purpose, Note/Loan, Business for Sale.

parameters.name: subtype
parameters.description: Subtypes, comma-separated (e.g. Gas Station, Shopping Center, QSR/Fast Food, Warehouse, Medical Office, Hotel).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum asking price (USD); unpriced listings are then left out.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Tenant brands, comma-separated (e.g. Starbucks, Dollar General).

parameters.name: tenant_credit
parameters.description: Tenant credit, comma-separated: Credit Rated, Corporate Guarantee, Franchisee.

parameters.name: investment_type
parameters.description: Investment type, e.g. Value Add, Core, Core Plus, Opportunistic, NNN.

parameters.name: opportunity_zone
parameters.description: true: only properties in an Opportunity Zone.

parameters.name: broker_id
parameters.description: Only this broker's listings (a broker id from /crexi/v1/listing).

parameters.name: include_unpriced
parameters.description: false: leave out listings without an asking price.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: asc or desc (default: asc for price and size, else desc).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
